description: React component that manages and displays listed blogging accounts, provides functionality to register new accounts, and displays information about the Listed platform within a preferences UI.

classes.name: Props
classes.description: TypeScript type defining properties for the Listed React component. Includes a WebApplication instance.

methods.name: reloadAccounts
methods.description: Asynchronously reloads the list of accounts from the application and updates state.

methods.name: registerNewAccount
methods.description: Handles the process of requesting a new listed account, confirming settings, and updating the accounts list.
